answer: The ledge holds work receipts rather than names, so the garden of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the karst of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
